description: This is a PHP test class for the BuzzPhotoController, specifically testing behavior after deleting a photo to verify proper response codes and cache handling in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoControllerAfterDeletePhotoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the BuzzPhotoController after deleting a photo, focusing on response status and cache handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by loading fixture data into the database.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Tests the handle method of the BuzzPhotoController after a photo has been deleted, ensuring it returns a 400 status code when the photo's ETag is cached.
